llama.d: wild or domesticated South American cud-chewing animal related to camels but smaller and lacking a hump

llano.d: an extensive grassy and nearly treeless plain (especially in Latin America)

llew llaw gyffes.d: son of Gwydion and Arianrhod; supported by magic of Gwydion; cursed by Arianrhod

llewelyn powys.d: British writer of essays; one of three literary brothers (1884-1939)

lloyd.d: United States comic actor in silent films; he used physical danger as a source of comedy (1893-1971)

lloyd webber.d: English composer of many successful musicals (some in collaboration with Sir Tim Rice) (born in 1948)
